text.zh_cn:
# 坠落试炼
高处的风景，往往以生命为代价。
- 摔落伤害按高度计算，可用 [item:minecraft:water_bucket] 缓冲
- [item:minecraft:hay_block] 与 [item:minecraft:slime_block] 可减轻冲击
- [item:minecraft:elytra] 让坠落化作飞翔
> 不死人跌入深渊之前，总来得及喝下最后一瓶水。
text.en_us:
# Trial of Falling
High places cost lives.
- Fall damage scales with height; cushion it with [item:minecraft:water_bucket]
- [item:minecraft:hay_block] and [item:minecraft:slime_block] soften the landing
- [item:minecraft:elytra] turns falling into flight
> Before the undead falls into the Abyss, one last flask is drunk.
